description: This file defines the CustomerGroup model class for the OpenCart project, responsible for retrieving customer group data from the database.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Model class for customer group data management in OpenCart, providing methods to retrieve customer group information from the database.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific customer group record by its ID, joining the customer_group and customer_group_description tables based on the current language.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all customer group records for the current language, ordered by sort order and name.
